info.title: Harari Region Prosperity Party Portal API
info.description: Read-only access to what the public site publishes, for the apps of the branch office. Every request needs a key in the X-Api-Key header. A Super Admin issues keys under Administration, API keys, each with the scopes and requests per minute its app needs. Answers carry an ETag: send it back in If-None-Match to get 304 when nothing changed. The member app also signs members in by SMS code and sends their token as a Bearer token.
